# The -1 Guarantee

> The -1 Guarantee is a Substack publication by Massimiliano Banini about Negative Price Guarantees ("-1"), measurable value, accountability, risk reversal, business systems, work, AI, and economic incentives.

Canonical articles are hosted on Substack. This GitHub Pages project provides a static discovery layer because the Substack archive is dynamically loaded.

## Full archive resources

- [Readable archive](https://massimilianobanini.github.io/theminusoneguarantee-sitemap/archive.html): Publication date, title, subtitle and canonical URL for every public article.
- [Markdown archive](https://massimilianobanini.github.io/theminusoneguarantee-sitemap/archive.md): Compact text version of the full archive.
- [JSON article index](https://massimilianobanini.github.io/theminusoneguarantee-sitemap/articles.json): Structured article metadata.
- [CSV article index](https://massimilianobanini.github.io/theminusoneguarantee-sitemap/articles.csv): Tabular article metadata.
- [XML sitemap](https://massimilianobanini.github.io/theminusoneguarantee-sitemap/sitemap.xml): Canonical article URLs and publication dates.
- [Text sitemap](https://massimilianobanini.github.io/theminusoneguarantee-sitemap/sitemap.txt): One canonical article URL per line.
